items.summary: FEATURE  Global e-commerce and auction site eBay reported better-than-expected second-quarter earnings and revenue, surpassing expectations across all key metrics, and raised its full-year forecast on Wednesday afternoon.

items.title: Etsy to Cut 12% of Workforce as It Simplifies Operations
items.summary: Etsy  said Wednesday that it will eliminate about 220 jobs, or roughly 12% of its workforce, as the online marketplace restructures around a simpler organization.  The board’s audit committee approved the plan on Aug. 3, saying it is intended to align Etsy with its long-term priorities and improve coordination and decision-making speed.  Etsy also authorized an additional $2 billion in share repurchases, with no expiration date.
